source_name: World Bank Digital Finance country snapshot — Ukraine
why_relevant: Country-level dashboard combining financial-inclusion indicators with enabling-regulation status for Ukraine; useful for tracking regulatory/infrastructure changes affecting payment acceptance.

source_name: IMF Financial Access Survey (FAS) dataset
why_relevant: Annual supply-side series reported by the NBU to the IMF: ATMs per 100,000 adults, POS terminals, branches, card transaction volumes/values for Ukraine — the single most comparable time series for ATM/POS estate sizing.

source_name: World Bank Open Data indicator FB.ATM.TOTL.P5 — ATMs per 100,000 adults, Ukraine
why_relevant: World Bank re-publication of the IMF FAS ATM series for Ukraine with a stable indicator API — convenient machine-readable access and long history, though the underlying source is FAS/NBU.

source_name: World Bank G20 Financial Inclusion Indicators — Ukraine country view
why_relevant: Curated G20 FI indicator set for Ukraine mixing Findex demand-side and FAS supply-side series (POS terminals, retail cashless transactions), useful for cross-country benchmarking of UA payments penetration.

source_name: World Bank Global Payment Systems Survey (GPSS) dataset & 'Payment Systems Worldwide' reports
why_relevant: Central-bank-reported qualitative+quantitative national payment system data (RTGS, retail schemes, card infrastructure, oversight, innovation) with Ukraine among responding economies; the sixth round (GPSS 2021) is the most recent snapshot and directly describes UA payment infrastructure.

source_name: World Bank Documents & Reports — Ukraine financial sector series
why_relevant: Full-text searchable repository of WB Ukraine financial-sector analytics, project appraisal documents and technical assistance reports; a Dec-2025 'Ukraine's Financial Sector' note was found here, and PADs typically name counterparty banks, systems and procurement.

source_name: IMF Ukraine country page & Staff Country Reports (EFF reviews, Article IV)
why_relevant: EFF review staff reports and Article IV consultations carry banking-sector data, NBU policy commitments, cash/digitalisation reform structural benchmarks and financial-sector resilience assessments; released several times a year.

source_name: IMF eLibrary (Ukraine staff country reports, structured metadata)
why_relevant: Structured, citable XML/HTML versions of the same IMF Ukraine reports; easier programmatic discovery of review numbering and dates than the main site.

source_name: IMF Ukrainian-language publications & Memorandum on Economic and Financial Policies (МЕФП)
why_relevant: The MEFP / Letter of Intent are published in Ukrainian by the NBU and MoF and contain the authorities' own commitments on financial-sector and payments reform — the local-language authoritative version of IMF conditionality.

source_name: EBRD Project Summary Documents — Ukraine filter
why_relevant: Per-project disclosures naming Ukrainian partner financial institutions, facility sizes and purposes (risk-sharing, trade facilitation, digitalisation); the closest thing to a public pipeline of who is being funded to modernise banking/payment infrastructure.

source_name: EBRD news & Ukraine country pages (annual investment totals, PFI deals)
why_relevant: Announces headline volumes and named partner banks (e.g. PrivatBank guarantees), giving early signal of which Ukrainian banks are receiving capacity to invest — a leading indicator for equipment and infrastructure demand.

source_name: IFC Project Disclosure Portal — Ukraine financial-sector projects
why_relevant: Discloses IFC investment and advisory projects with Ukrainian banks (risk-sharing facilities, credit reporting, 'Digital Finance Future Ukraine' advisory ~$2.83m) — names client institutions and the digital-payments workstreams being funded.

source_name: IFC pressroom — Ukraine financial sector partnerships (incl. NBU MoU)
why_relevant: Announcements of IFC–NBU cooperation and digital finance programmes give the policy framing and timing that later appear as procurement or regulatory change.

source_name: EIB Group in Ukraine — projects, publications and press
why_relevant: EIB discloses Ukraine lending envelopes and intermediated facilities (e.g. Ukrgasbank disbursement under the Ukraine Economic Resilience Facility) plus the 'projects to be financed' pipeline; identifies financial intermediaries and infrastructure scope.

source_name: USAID Financial Sector Reform / Financial Sector Transformation programme materials hosted by NBU
why_relevant: Donor-funded programme pages and research PDFs carry hard numbers on POS terminal counts, card-accepting trade points and financial-literacy/inclusion survey results for Ukraine — directly on-topic for ATM/POS and cash-usage tracking.

source_name: Ukraine Donor Platform (G7/IFI coordination, project & support matrices)
why_relevant: Central coordination hub listing which IFI/donor (WB, IFC, EBRD, EIB, CEB, IMF, OECD) is doing what in Ukraine's private and financial sector — an efficient snowball point into individual programme documents.

source_name: Ministry of Finance of Ukraine — cooperation with IFIs (World Bank / EBRD pages, uk)
why_relevant: Ukrainian government's own accounting of IFI portfolios (amounts approved/disbursed, project lists) in Ukrainian — authoritative local-language counterpart to IFI disclosures and often more current on state-sector projects.

source_name: Ministry for Development of Communities and Territories / Restoration — IFI project pages (uk)
why_relevant: Ukrainian-language register of EBRD/EIB infrastructure projects; mostly transport/energy but useful for cross-checking IFI project naming conventions and identifying any digital/financial infrastructure components.

source_name: EU4Business initiative — Ukraine country reports and guarantee facility data
why_relevant: EU/EIF-backed SME finance programme reporting for Ukraine; country reports quantify credit flows through partner banks and digitalisation support, providing donor-side context for merchant/POS acceptance growth.

source_name: EU capacity4dev Ukraine library
why_relevant: Repository of EU programme documents and evaluations for Ukraine; a snowball route to EU-funded financial-sector and digitalisation technical assistance reports not indexed elsewhere.

source_name: FRED (St. Louis Fed) mirror of IMF FAS Ukraine series
why_relevant: Clean API/CSV access to IMF FAS Ukraine geographical-outreach series (ATMs per 100k adults) with vintage tracking; convenient for automated time-series ingestion when IMF endpoints are awkward.

source_name: National Institute for Strategic Studies (NISS) analyses of IFI project implementation and financial inclusion (uk)
why_relevant: Ukrainian state think-tank commentary on how IFI investment projects are actually implemented and on financial-inclusion policy directions; reveals bottlenecks and named programmes that IFI press releases smooth over.
